simulator.note: Boots as the M3602 family with chip ID 0x3603 (C3603, chips/m3602.py, run_dump_minihd_galaxy_1705_app_starts.py, run_dump_minihd_galaxy_1705_capture_screen.py): the "M3606F 1.1.3" bootloader prints "APP  init ok", parks the SEE boot stub at 0xA1E8F988, unpacks seecode ("M3606 SEE") to 0xA7000200 and maincode(AV) to 0x80000200, and starts both cores (EBase 0x80000000 / 0x80000001).  The application prints "stb_tuner_type = 1, stb_board_type =8." and "sys_ic_get_chip_id=0x10047 sys_ic_get_rev_id =0x20001", configures the ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33, populates userdb(64+64) at 0x73FF80, and renders its 1280x720 ARGB8888 OSD through GeM36F / GMA layer 0.

desc: Amiko Mini HD (System ID 0A070A00) firmware Galaxy 1.7.05 by Dekolte (2016-3-31) on an 8 MB SPI flash for the compact ALi M3606F / C3603 Full HD DVB-S2 satellite receiver.
Uses a dual-CPU "M3606 SEE" architecture with SEE running at 0xA7000200, an ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33, and a 44-entry 0x44xx remote control table ("necfirst" coding).
